# Our Extra Weeks

> Owner-direct rentals of luxury timeshare weeks at the Westin Ka'anapali Ocean Resort Villas and Villas North (Ka'anapali, Maui, Hawaii), the Westin Kierland Villas (Scottsdale, Arizona) and Garza Blanca resorts (Puerto Vallarta, Cancún and Los Cabos, Mexico). One- and two-bedroom villas, no broker fees, booked directly with the owners.

## Frequently asked questions

### Can I rent a Westin Ka'anapali, Westin Kierland or Garza Blanca timeshare week directly from the owner?
Yes. Our Extra Weeks is a family and a small group of friends who own timeshare weeks at the Westin Ka'anapali Ocean Resort Villas and Villas North (Maui), the Westin Kierland Villas (Scottsdale), and Garza Blanca (Puerto Vallarta, Cancún and Los Cabos). We have been renting the weeks we can't use directly to travellers since 2016, with no broker fees, and we transfer the reservation into your name with the resort.

### How much does a week cost?
Prices are for the whole 7-night week in US dollars, booked direct: Maui spring break 2027 from $4,400; Maui Christmas/New Year 2027 from $6,600; Scottsdale (Westin Kierland) March 2027 from $4,150; Garza Blanca Puerto Vallarta Christmas 2027 from $5,600. The full list of available weeks, with dates and prices, is on this page.

### Is booking direct cheaper than RedWeek?
Yes. Our weeks are also listed on RedWeek, where renters pay RedWeek's service fee (about 9.5%) on top of the rental price. We price every week at least $500 below what the same week costs on RedWeek. RedWeek is still available if you prefer to pay by credit card or want its booking protection.

### How does booking work?
Send an inquiry. We send a rental agreement to sign and need your full legal name, address as shown on your ID, email and phone number, because the resort checks photo ID at check-in. A 50% deposit is due when you sign. We then put the reservation in your name with the resort and send you the confirmation (you can call the resort to verify). The balance is due once the reservation is in your name.

### How do I pay?
By Zelle, Interac e-Transfer (we provide the Canadian dollar equivalent) or PayPal Friends & Family. All amounts are in US dollars, and any transaction fees are paid by the payer.

### What is the cancellation policy?
All bookings are final. There are no cancellations or refunds once the reservation has been transferred into your name.

### What are the villas like?
One- and two-bedroom resort villas with full resort amenities. Two-bedroom villas at the Westin resorts sleep up to 8 and have a full kitchen and in-unit washer and dryer. Any fees the resort itself charges at check-in, such as Hawaii state occupancy fees, are separate and paid to the resort.

### Is 2026 available?
No, 2026 is sold out. We are now booking 2027.

### What if I don't see the dates I want?
Use the request form on this page or email ourextraweeks@gmail.com with the resort and week you want. We usually secure weeks about a year ahead, so we can't promise specific dates, but we'll check.

### Can a travel agent book for a client?
Yes. Travel agents and resellers can book a week on behalf of a client; we hold the reservation and update the guest name once confirmed.

## How to book
Use the inquiry form at https://ourextraweeks.com/#contact or email ourextraweeks@gmail.com.
